verdict.rationale: Firstbase is a back-office and incorporation SaaS, so operating it through natural-language commands is a fair axis, but the evidence pack documents no AI assistant or natural-language command interface. The only conversational feature is messaging a human bookkeeper, which is an adjacent human-service channel, not natural-language operation of the product. Probes also found no llms.txt or OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
